long_biography.plain_text:
Massimo Musa led the Laser Vision Institute, a chain specialising in competitively priced eye surgery. Its operation was paired with the Eye Glass World retail chain. Lasers were transported between outpatient centres, while travelling surgeons worked across the network.

Musa also worked with Daniel Stanton on optical retail businesses. The two served as managers of Daniel & Max, a company within the Now Optics group. Its Stanton Optical stores combine eyewear sales with examinations by independent eye doctors. The group uses remote connections to doctors and software covering appointments, examinations and the collection of glasses.
long_biography.html:
Massimo Musa led the Laser Vision Institute, a chain specialising in competitively priced eye surgery. Its operation was paired with the Eye Glass World retail chain. Lasers were transported between outpatient centres, while travelling surgeons worked across the network.

Musa also worked with Daniel Stanton on optical retail businesses. The two served as managers of Daniel & Max, a company within the Now Optics group. Its Stanton Optical stores combine eyewear sales with examinations by independent eye doctors. The group uses remote connections to doctors and software covering appointments, examinations and the collection of glasses.
